# Component inventory

Every recipe in `src/components/ui/`, its axes and its option values, generated from the
source by `scripts/design-system-docs.mjs` and rechecked by `npm run design-system:check`. A
component missing from this list does not exist yet, and a value missing from an axis is not one
of its options.
